author: Incredibilis7
quote: First 12-15 hours of the game you spend being a cuck / simp doing chores such as fixing sinks, painting walls and buying groceries + all the restrictions on killing people like at protests, clubs and from trains. I mean it would be a great dating sim or sims game more generally, but this is not a GTA game. Constantly below 30 fps and full of bugs in 2026 (despite waiting 13 years for the game) is also unacceptable. It is only getting a one because the graphics are pretty (but as gameplay is 90% ****, it’s not getting anything higher).
